summary: Iteration 3 regression+features verified on mobile viewport (390x844). Backend 4/4 tests passed: list active notes, create handwriting note with drawing_data, GET persistence, soft-delete + restore, nested folders via parent_id. Frontend: handwriting prep popup (hw-prep-title, hw-size-a4, hw-template-grid, hw-create) all visible & working, FAB creates handwriting note and routes to /draw/{id} which mounts cleanly with ZERO JS pageerrors (previous crash fix confirmed). All drawing tools render (tool-pen/fountain/marker/highlighter/pencil/eraser/shape). Home top bar contains hamburger + sort-btn + toggle-view-btn + settings-btn (no bottom tab bar - role=tablist absent). sort-btn menu shows sort-updated/created/title and reorders. settings-btn navigates to /settings which renders toggle-palm-rejection switch in S PEN & GESTURES section. template-sheet-title shows 'NEW NOTE' in compact 240px popup. Only minor: harmless RN-web deprecation warnings (shadow*, pointerEvents).

react_native_issues.issue: Console deprecation warnings: 'shadow*' style props deprecated (use boxShadow) and props.pointerEvents deprecated (use style.pointerEvents). Non-blocking but should be migrated. Affects /app/frontend/app/index.tsx (fab/tplPopup/folderPopup shadowColor/shadowOffset/shadowOpacity/shadowRadius) and /app/frontend/app/draw/[id].tsx (toolOptCard).

action_items: Optional cleanup: migrate shadow* style props to boxShadow and props.pointerEvents to style.pointerEvents to silence RN-web deprecation warnings (non-blocking).
critical_code_review_comments: app/index.tsx is ~1500 lines; consider splitting Home into Drawer/TemplatePopup/HwPrep subcomponents for maintainability.
draw/[id].tsx is ~1430 lines; could extract PaperBackground/PaperFrame and the more-menu sheet.
Backend server.py correctly excludes Mongo _id via projection {'_id':0} — good.
All API endpoints under /api prefix and use env vars; CORS open (intended for preview).
seed_data_creation: Test notes/folders prefixed TEST_ are cleaned up by each test (delete + permanent delete).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 3 passed cleanly. Previous /draw/{id} crash is fixed (verified via mounting + no JS errors with Skia <Group transform>). Bottom tab bar fully removed. Skia canvas drawing itself is native-only — not testable in web preview, only mount-level verification. The frontend .env key is EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL (note: prefix). Reuse /app/backend/tests/test_notes_iter3.py for regression.
